name: intellisys-monorepo
description: Root-level orchestration for Intellisys frontend and backend testing

scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run merge:coverage && node coverage-reporter.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:frontend: cd intellisys && npm run lint || npx eslint intellisys/src --ext .js,.jsx,.ts,.tsx
scripts.lint:backend: cd ShraddhaBackend && npm run lint || npx eslint ShraddhaBackend --ext .js
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd intellisys && npm install && cd ../ShraddhaBackend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
